scope.historical: Separate earlier campaign; cross-time comparison, not pairing or isolated source causality.
scope.replay: Exact saved34 metadata_on ELF and original harness. Matching hashes do not reproduce scheduling/cache/filesystem history.
scope.rebuilt: Freshly built public Resident34/harness; equal corpus/traces/counts do not prove ABI, compiler, validation placement or adapter equivalence.
scope.comparison: Descriptive4process cells; all adverse rows retained. LocalLMDB drift is reported, never normalized away. No confidence or nonregression proof.
scope.sampling: Separate timer-inclusive latency phase; write p99 has only8 samples/trial. Query binding/prepared-reader scope follows the harness.
scope.integrity: Checks report validation flags, exact config, binary metadata, trace/corpus identity, raw digests and pertrial p99. Not a source/native/WAL authority audit.

estimators.mean: Arithmetic16trial elapsed/operation perprocess; geomean4process ns. Writes ns/transaction; throughput batch×1e9/mean.
estimators.sample_p99: Geomean16timer-inclusive trial p99 perprocess, then geomean4process values; exact original34 estimator.
estimators.pooled_p99: Nearest-rank p99 of all sampled latencies within each process, then geomean4process values. Supplemental, not population p99.
